description: This file defines the EcsCredentialProvider class used for fetching container credentials in an AWS environment via HTTP requests to the container's metadata service. It implements a credential provider interface for loading credentials asynchronously with retry support.

classes.name: Aws\Credentials\EcsCredentialProvider
classes.description: Credential provider class for fetching AWS ECS container credentials via the metadata service.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the provider with optional configuration such as timeout, retries, and HTTP client.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Loads container credentials asynchronously as a Promise.

methods.name: getAttempts
methods.description: Returns the number of credential retrieval attempts made.

methods.name: getEcsAuthToken
methods.description: Retrieves the authorization token used for ECS credential requests.

methods.name: getHeadersForAuthToken
methods.description: Builds request headers including the authorization token if available.

methods.name: setHeaderForAuthToken
methods.description: Deprecated method to set headers with the authorization token.

methods.name: getEcsUri
methods.description: Constructs the URI to access container credentials from environment variables.

methods.name: decodeResult
methods.description: Parses and validates the credential JSON response.

methods.name: isCompatibleUri
methods.description: Checks if the provided URI belongs to a valid ECS metadata endpoint.
